Our model utilizes the Pytorch-based (Paszke et al., 2019) Huggingface Transformers (Wolf et al., 2020) packages and is designed to reconstruct sequences with a length of 5 for fMRI2text and 10 for EEG2text in Phase 2. Additional hyperparameters can be found in Appendix A. Both datasets are split into train, validation, test sets with a ratio of $70\%$ , $15\%$ , $15\%$ respectively. We follow the same evaluation strategy as Wang and Ji (2022) to establish a fair comparison and gain insights into the optimal performance scenario of UniCoRN.
